description: You are a power quality engineer at a large manufacturing plant. A 3-phase, 400 V (line-to-line) distribution feeder is supplying a production line. Your clamp meter measurements show the feeder is carrying 24 amperes of line current at a power factor of 0.80 lagging. You need to complete a power audit report that requires documenting all three power components of this feeder: the apparent power, the true (real) power, and the reactive power. Calculate all three values using this app and verify that the reactive power is consistent with the real power and apparent power you calculated.
